cases.purpose: Classify a driver PTY and /dev/null, compare tty-name to an independent tty(1), and close an actual tty descriptor twice.
cases.oracle: Reference uses Python os.isatty, os.ttyname and os.close on the same private controlling PTY; tty(1) and the driver’s recorded tty_name independently identify the device.
cases.comparison: Terminal steps assert both classifications, an exact /dev/pts path shape and close/duplicate-close; the raw path is retained against tty_name in each VM result.
cases.candidate_script:
exec 9</dev/null
if pty isatty 0 && ! pty isatty 9; then printf 'CLASSIFY=PASS\n'; else exit 1; fi
exec 9<&-
name=$(pty tty-name 0) || exit 1
other=$(/usr/bin/tty) || exit 1
[[ $name == "$other" && $name =~ ^/dev/pts/[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 1
printf 'TTY=%s\n' "$name"
exec 9<>/dev/tty
pty close 9 || exit 1
[[ ! -e /proc/$BASHPID/fd/9 ]] || exit 1
if pty close 9 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
printf 'CLOSE=PASS\n'
cases.reference_script:
/usr/bin/python3 -c '
import errno, os, re
f = os.open("/dev/null", os.O_RDONLY)
assert os.isatty(0) and not os.isatty(f)
os.close(f)
print("CLASSIFY=PASS", flush=True)
name = os.ttyname(0)
assert re.fullmatch(r"/dev/pts/[0-9]+", name)
print("TTY=" + name, flush=True)
f = os.open("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR)
os.close(f)
try: os.close(f)
except OSError as exc: assert exc.errno == errno.EBADF
else: raise AssertionError("double close succeeded")
print("CLOSE=PASS", flush=True)
'

cases.purpose: Observe all four echo flags, suppressed input, and restored visible input on the private PTY.
cases.oracle: The independent reference applies stty flag operations; the VM PTY driver reads termios from the slave and captures the actual typed bytes.
cases.comparison: Assert ECHO/ECHOE/ECHOK/ECHONL are clear and later set, hidden input is absent from the raw stream, visible input is echoed, both reads succeed and original modes are restored.
cases.candidate_script:
saved=$(/usr/bin/stty -g) || exit 1
trap '/usr/bin/stty "$saved"' EXIT
/usr/bin/stty echo echoe echok echonl || exit 1
pty echo 0 off || exit 1
printf 'ECHO-OFF-READY\n'
IFS= read -r secret || exit 1
[[ $secret == HIDDEN-4f7c ]] || exit 1
printf 'SECRET-ACCEPTED\n'
pty echo 0 on || exit 1
printf 'ECHO-ON-READY\n'
IFS= read -r visible || exit 1
[[ $visible == VISIBLE-28ba ]] || exit 1
printf 'VISIBLE-ACCEPTED\n'
cases.reference_script:
saved=$(/usr/bin/stty -g) || exit 1
trap '/usr/bin/stty "$saved"' EXIT
/usr/bin/stty echo echoe echok echonl || exit 1
/usr/bin/stty -echo -echoe -echok -echonl || exit 1
printf 'ECHO-OFF-READY\n'
IFS= read -r secret || exit 1
[[ $secret == HIDDEN-4f7c ]] || exit 1
printf 'SECRET-ACCEPTED\n'
/usr/bin/stty echo echoe echok echonl || exit 1
printf 'ECHO-ON-READY\n'
IFS= read -r visible || exit 1
[[ $visible == VISIBLE-28ba ]] || exit 1
printf 'VISIBLE-ACCEPTED\n'

cases.purpose: Resize the controlling PTY and observe SIGWINCH and rows/columns independently.
cases.oracle: The reference invokes stty rows/cols; a shell trap observes kernel SIGWINCH and stty size independently reads TIOCGWINSZ.
cases.comparison: The terminal driver requires the WINCH marker, literal 37 113 geometry, normal completion, and no surviving process.
cases.candidate_script:
trap 'printf "SIGNAL=WINCH\n"' WINCH
pty resize 0 -W 113 -H 37 || exit 1
printf 'GEOMETRY='
/usr/bin/stty size || exit 1
printf 'RESIZE-DONE\n'
cases.reference_script:
trap 'printf "SIGNAL=WINCH\n"' WINCH
/usr/bin/stty rows 37 cols 113 || exit 1
printf 'GEOMETRY='
/usr/bin/stty size || exit 1
printf 'RESIZE-DONE\n'

cases.purpose: Create a private broker, inspect status and access controls, and require owned-child and session cleanup.
cases.oracle: Documented broker API plus independent stat ownership/mode checks, procfs process existence, a fixture-owned sleep child and a Python private-PTY facility control. /root is only lstat-ed as a wrong-owner 0700 inode.
cases.comparison: Require literal PASS predicates for ready status and geometry, live child, exact list, private directory modes, both EACCES rejection paths, termination, disappearance from status/list and no live child; raw bounded command output and error files are saved.
cases.setup_script: /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,stat; s=os.stat("/root"); assert os.geteuid()!=0 and s.st_uid!=os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o700; m,t=os.openpty(); assert os.isatty(t); os.close(m); os.close(t)'
cases.script:
root=$HOME/broker-root
bad=$HOME/broker-wrong-mode
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$root" || exit 1
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 755 "$bad" || exit 1
trap 'ptybroker terminate "$root" one >/dev/null 2>&1 || :' EXIT
failed=0
check() { if "$@"; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$label"; failed=1; fi; }
ptybroker create "$root" one --rows 24 --cols 80 -- /usr/bin/sleep 8 >"$HOME/broker-create.log" 2>"$HOME/broker-create.err"; create_rc=$?
status=$(ptybroker status "$root" one 2>"$HOME/broker-status.err"); status_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$status" >"$HOME/broker-status.log"
pid=0
if [[ $status =~ child_pid=([0-9]+) ]]; then pid=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; fi
label=ready-status; check test "$create_rc" = 0 -a "$status_rc" = 0
label=running-geometry; if [[ $status == *'id=one '* && $status == *'running=1 '* && $status == *'rows=24 cols=80 '* && $pid != 0 && -e /proc/$pid ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$label"; failed=1; fi
listing=$(ptybroker list "$root" 2>"$HOME/broker-list.err"); list_rc=$?
label=list-session; if [[ $list_rc == 0 && $listing == one ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$label"; failed=1; fi
root_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -c '%a:%u' "$root")
session_mode=$(/usr/bin/stat -c '%a:%u' "$root/one" 2>/dev/null)
label=private-directories; if [[ $root_mode == 700:$EUID && $session_mode == 700:$EUID ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$label"; failed=1; fi
ptybroker list "$bad" >"$HOME/broker-bad-mode.out" 2>"$HOME/broker-bad-mode.err"; bad_rc=$?
label=wrong-mode-eacces; if [[ $bad_rc == 1 && $(<"$HOME/broker-bad-mode.err") == *'Permission denied'* ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$label"; failed=1; fi
ptybroker list /root >"$HOME/broker-bad-owner.out" 2>"$HOME/broker-bad-owner.err"; bad_rc=$?
label=wrong-owner-eacces; if [[ $bad_rc == 1 && $(<"$HOME/broker-bad-owner.err") == *'Permission denied'* ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$label"; failed=1; fi
ptybroker terminate "$root" one >"$HOME/broker-terminate.out" 2>"$HOME/broker-terminate.err"; term_rc=$?
label=terminate; check test "$term_rc" = 0
ptybroker status "$root" one >"$HOME/broker-after-status.out" 2>"$HOME/broker-after-status.err"; after_rc=$?
after=$(ptybroker list "$root" 2>"$HOME/broker-after-list.err"); after_list_rc=$?
label=removed-from-status-and-list; if [[ $after_rc != 0 && $after_list_rc == 0 && -z $after && ! -e $root/one ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$label"; failed=1; fi
label=owned-child-reaped; if [[ $pid != 0 && ! -e /proc/$pid ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$label"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$label"; failed=1; fi
exit "$failed"
cases.stdout:
ready-status=PASS
running-geometry=PASS
list-session=PASS
private-directories=PASS
wrong-mode-eacces=PASS
wrong-owner-eacces=PASS
terminate=PASS
removed-from-status-and-list=PASS
owned-child-reaped=PASS
